verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a community remark that teams shared collections by exporting and importing JSON files. First-party docs mention the Postman Collection format and programmatic asset management through the Postman API, but never document import or export itself. missing for 10: first-party documentation of collection import/export, supported portable formats (e.g., OpenAPI, cURL, HAR), evidence of moving collections into or out of other tools, independent hands-on corroboration.
